fichas.title: Kitchens and kitchen types
fichas.summary: The page describes compact kitchenettes, kitchens designed primarily as workspaces, kitchens with dining areas, and open kitchens. Working kitchens use one-row, two-row, or U-shaped layouts, with equipment and worktops arranged for efficient work. Dining-area kitchens accommodate a table and seating; open kitchens connect to living and dining areas and require effective ventilation and extraction. Diagrams illustrate example layouts and working-area relationships.
